Swim: 3D car models

Every car and every traffic vehicle in Swim is built from a model shared on Sketchfab under the
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Thank you to the artists.

Changes made for the game, to every model: maker badges, logos, lettering, number plates and most of the
interior removed; simplified to a lighter mesh (and a lighter phone version); turned, centred and rescaled;
materials replaced with the game's own (paint colour chosen in game). The models are provided as is, with no
warranties, as the licence says.

Racing cars (public/vendor/models/swim/cars):
  civic    (FL5 Hatch): model by shindedhirendra780, https://sketchfab.com/shindedhirendra780, https://sketchfab.com/models/770a5c9b025449f59769d8cd27d915bb, CC BY 4.0
  mustang  (Pony GT): model by Jesterz86, https://sketchfab.com/Jesterz86, https://sketchfab.com/models/dd4365565b6b4e0ea6c06a1ca4113e3e, CC BY 4.0
  m3       (G80 Sedan): model by SLBofficial, https://sketchfab.com/SLBofficial, https://sketchfab.com/models/0550ac4d2a3846b3bb75370eb8ef84c1, CC BY 4.0
  supra    (A80 Coupe): model by supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/models/74db03c309124369b785dca48c937b71, CC BY 4.0
  gtr      (R35 Coupe): model by Ciasny, https://sketchfab.com/Ciasny, https://sketchfab.com/models/51c912a8310c4e00a82ad7673d84228a, CC BY 4.0
  hellcat  (Blower): model by Lambo_SC04, https://sketchfab.com/Lambo_SC04, https://sketchfab.com/models/38a1fd572beb433fa2d26d8c1070c8fa, CC BY 4.0
  c8       (C8): model by Haris3D, https://sketchfab.com/Haris3D, https://sketchfab.com/models/790c40ccff6843eab0b7b4bd18421ff8, CC BY 4.0
  gt3      (992 Track): model by sohyalebret, https://sketchfab.com/sohyalebret, https://sketchfab.com/models/39df8be273464c6980171f5758bfde97, CC BY 4.0
  huracan  (Toro V10): model by supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/models/4620514b837b45cbaafef0dc637ae2d8, CC BY 4.0
